# Portfolio {#sec-portfolio}

*This section covers* multi-unit books — several aggregates combined, priced, and
allocated. Three recipes:

- **@sec-portfolio-construction** — build a portfolio from units; the
  independent-sum FFT and the diversification it delivers.
- **@sec-portfolio-pricing** — price with a distortion and allocate the premium
  back to units (natural allocation).
- **@sec-portfolio-samples** — dependence via the sample path (the *switcheroo*):
  couple units with a copula and read the result back as a sample.
